name: You Scream, I Scream...
label: Quest
description: You Scream, I Scream...: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: ICE CREAM! Oh please please please could you get me some ice cream?! Strawberry is my favorite flavor, and there's no better strawberry ice cream in the world than Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream! It's my favorite ice cream in the whole wide world!

I had it once a long time ago when I was at the Shimmering Flats race track, but I heard that they might be selling them in town now! Please? Pretty please? With Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream on top??!?!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I wish they'd make more flavors of ice cream other than strawberry, but I guess I'm lucky that strawberry is my favorite!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mmmmmmmmm! I love their strawberry ice cream! If there's one thing Tigule and Foror know to do, it's make ice cream!
Thank you very much friend - this is the best treat ever!
